info.name: Integriq — ORI public serving parity (ori-public-serving)
info.description: ori-public-serving: TC-1, TC-2, TC-3 (all eleven resources diffed against OriController), TC-4, TC-5, TC-7, TC-8 to TC-11 and TC-13 of openspec/changes/ori-public-serving/test-plan.md. Anonymous single-object reads on the ori-parity/v1 endpoints answer 404, never 403, for an amendment asked for as a motion (the endpoint's fixedFilters, REQ-EP-010), a draft meeting, and a publication dated in the future; each is compared with decidiq's own OriController, and the amendment is served under /amendments, so the guard is shown to be selective. TC-10 is the Risk 3 check: if the endpoint answers 200 where OriController answers 404, the publish-window gate needs its own filter. The objects are staged in decidiq's register through OpenRegister's objects API under this run's marker and deleted again. Precondition: decidiq is installed; without its register the first request stops the run. Run with tests/postman/integriq.postman_environment.json. Not here: TC-6 (needs a governance body with an email), TC-12 (121 requests in a minute, a performance run) and TC-14 (the RIS poll job, a regression outside this API).

item.name: Precondition: decidiq's register is installed (otherwise the run stops here)

exec: console.log('decidiq is not installed on this instance: the ORI parity checks need its register and OriController, so the run stops.');

item.name: Stage: a public amendment (Decision with decisionType amendment)

exec: pm.test('the staged object has an id', () => pm.expect(pm.collectionVariables.get('oriAmendment')).to.not.eql(''));

item.name: TC-8: the amendment is not served as a motion

exec: pm.test('an amendment under /motions: 404, the same as an unknown id', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404));
pm.test('never 403: hidden and unknown look the same (TC-11)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.eql(403));

item.name: TC-8 control: the same amendment is served under /amendments (the guard is selective, not vacuous)

exec: pm.test('an amendment under /amendments answers 200', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));

item.name: TC-8 parity: OriController hides it under /motions too

exec: pm.test('OriController answers 404 for an amendment under /motions', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404));

item.name: Stage: a draft meeting

exec: pm.test('the staged object has an id', () => pm.expect(pm.collectionVariables.get('oriDraftMeeting')).to.not.eql(''));

item.name: TC-9: a draft meeting is not served

exec: pm.test('a draft meeting: 404, the same as an unknown id', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404));
pm.test('never 403: hidden and unknown look the same (TC-11)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.eql(403));

item.name: TC-9 parity: OriController hides the draft meeting too

exec: pm.test('OriController answers 404 for a draft meeting', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404));

item.name: Stage: a publication dated in the future

exec: pm.test('the staged object has an id', () => pm.expect(pm.collectionVariables.get('oriFuturePublication')).to.not.eql(''));

item.name: TC-10 control: OriController hides the future publication

exec: pm.test('OriController answers 404 for a publication not yet live', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404));

item.name: TC-10: the endpoint hides the future publication as OriController does (Risk 3)

exec: pm.test('a publication not yet live: 404, the same as an unknown id', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404));
pm.test('never 403: hidden and unknown look the same (TC-11)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.eql(403));
pm.test('the endpoint answers what OriController answers', () => pm.expect(String(pm.response.code)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('oriControlStatus')));
console.log('Risk 3 does not hold: the publish-window gate needs its own fixed filter on the publications endpoint.');
